battery_capture_unavailable: Live BatteryStats experiments need a Rust capture adapter. Selecting a device does not authorize capture, app launch or a global reset.
battery_historian_unavailable: Bugreport collection and the Legacy Historian adapter are not connected. No bugreport is generated or uploaded.
battery_configuration_unavailable: Capture settings are read-only until the Rust battery capture adapter is connected. They do not configure imported reports.
battery_imported_count: {count} imported report · not a saved capture session
battery_no_sessions: No imported reports. Import an analysis from the File menu.
battery_session_store_unavailable: Saved Battery sessions are not connected in Rust. Only the current imported report is listed.
battery_refresh_unavailable: There is no saved-session index to refresh. Re-import a report to reload its contents.
battery_empty_hint: Import a schema-v1 battery analysis from the File menu. No device capture or reset is performed when this page opens.
battery_derived_notice: Imported derived report: source labels are not independently verified; raw snapshot continuity and per-package ownership are not established.
battery_energy_omitted: {count} energy records retained in details; incompatible components, sources or scopes are not combined into one scalar.
battery_baseline_unavailable: Compatible baseline comparison is unavailable: this report does not establish matching workload, boot, accumulator, charging and thermal conditions.
battery_export_scope: File exports contain the published runs page only; not a raw evidence bundle or a lossless session archive.
battery_warning_scope: Imported diagnostics are retained verbatim; they are not newly verified findings.
battery_more_warnings: {count} more diagnostics omitted from this view
battery_status_retained: Operation ended; the previously published report is retained.
battery_config_read_only: Reference options only — capture settings are not applied.
battery_timer_coverage: Reported timer records only; omitted resource arrays are unavailable, not zero activity.
battery_energy_unverified: Source, scope and confidence are imported labels, not independent verification or hardware-measurement proof.
